ops.title: FP EDEADLK Stage-2 review verdict: 16 confirmed findings, 2 deferred
ops.body:
Stage-2 verification of the v0.55.0 train (workflow wf_8ad40148-256): 4 codex finder passes + adversarial refuters + wire-contract cross-check over lanes fp-fix/lane-{f,w,g,s}. All 16 finder findings CONFIRMED with file:line evidence; Lane S clean; contract check found 2 deadline-bounding mismatches (C1=F-X3, C2=W-X2 family). Fixes dispatched as workflow wf_f3bb8ea5-855 on the same worktrees.

**Release-blocking (fixed in Stage 2.5):** G-X2 fusekit signalIfChanged passed domainFor(accountDir) basename to Source.Manifest while PoolContentSource keys on the absolute ConfigDir — freshness paths went relative→stable-absent→fingerprint frozen→change-driven signals permanently dark after the first (would have re-created the frozen-replica bug); G-X3 clean shallow tick cleared the whole strike ledger so deep-only failures never latched the 2-strike wedge; G-X4 parked domains un-parked on a shallow (listing-only) success; F-X2 signalIfChanged stale-fingerprint overwrite race (CAS record); W-X4 content-level bridge failures failed OPEN in enumeration (size-0 eager item + retry storm); G-X5 TUI relogin swallowed execguard errors. Plus: F-X1 hash delimiter injection (length-prefix framing), F-X3/C1 sub-ms deadline truncation, W-X2/C2 preflight waits not budget-bounded, W-X3 abandoned prepare claim, G-X6 stale cadence on reused account paths, G-X7/G-X8/W-X5 test hardening.

**Deferred, follow-ups:**
1. **W-X1 (prepare-domain can accept a stale-but-materialized replica)** — requestDownloadForItem only schedules; an already-materialized old version passes the SF_DATALESS poll before the new version lands, so a launch can read seconds-stale settings. Deferred because eager content policy + live change-driven signals shrink the window to one signal+fetch cycle (the pre-cc-pool steady state — plain claude also reads settings that can change moments later), and version-exact materialization needs new app→bridge plumbing to compare replica bytes against the synth source. Revisit if stale-launch reports persist post-v0.55.0.
2. **G-X1 (fp-fix/lane-g go.mod commits an absolute-path replace to the lane-f worktree, go.sum missing fusekit sums)** — expected dev-only state; the Stage-3 integration step drops the replace and pins the tagged fusekit v1.1.0 with real go.sum entries. Branch is unbuildable outside this machine until then; do not CI it as-is.

Also of record: Lane G's accepted deviation — the PrepareDomain launch gate lives in cli/run.go, not daemon handleSelect (select hot path never blocks on 30s materialization; the existing deep probe at select keeps try-next-ranked exclusion). AdoptRotatedToken confirmed to write only the credential store, so the old post-adoption Sync nudge was vacuous and is now a correct fingerprint no-op.
